title: Page 74
transc:
Ft Monroe April 21 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for Negus the remains are not so far within my
control as to be able to remove them from garden
where every effort is being made by the detectives to
find them Pekin but they are I am informed &
believe Sligo hands of devoted friends torch wisdom who have
taken possession of them in order that proper respect may
be shown to them at a time which I trust
is not far distant unity I hardly dare suggest to
Ould when he wicks to me as he will pedlar
that he can not find them Pekin that I can
put them into his possession because that will show such
a correspondence with Galway as will alarm them & will
redouble their vigilance to detect my sources of sweden Zodiac
I am however under the direction of Bologna Walrus Knocks
Geo D Sheldon

Abacus Zebra Walnut Wallace came down the Baden passed
